description: C41, after W44, W45 and W46. The autopilot starts an audit session (named audit-<date>, counted in the cap, run on Sonnet: drafting proposals from a record is judgement, not a build) when the newest record in [audit] dir is older than [audit] every_days or more than [audit] every_merges job merges old. Its prompt: git pull, wsc audit --record, wsc proposals draft and fill each (options, apply recipes, recommendation, tag), wsc proposals close for the re-measured ones, push plan/audit-<date> with the record and the proposals, open the pull request. docs/AUDIT.md is the session's short procedure: what a good option is, at most [audit] max_questions open at once, a tagged proposal never defaults, a declined one is not re-raised inside its margin. Host tests on the tick.
title: Autopilot runs the audit loop: a cadence, an audit session and its proposals
